name: Claude notes
author: Brett
description: The hub's shared Claude files (/projects/_shared/_claude/notes: handoffs, session logs, plans, install notes, saved commands) as the capability axf.notes@1 (list, read, write only when nobody else changed the file, rename, move, delete with history kept on the hub), read and edited in MD Studio's Notes scope. No screen of its own (Nov 12 2026): the console's Notes screen is AmberX's notes and to-do manager (the amberx-notes plugin), never a second notes manager.
